description: CVEs published or updated in a window, filtered to the ones that matter: in CISA KEV (`kev_only`), with a public exploit (`has_exploit`), by severity, vendor or product. Use for 'what should we patch this week' and 'is anything in our stack being exploited'. 1 credit.

days.description: window in days (free keys: up to 7)

has_exploit.description: only CVEs with a public exploit

kev_only.description: only CVEs in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue

product.description: CPE product, e.g. windows, ios, fortios

vendor.description: CPE vendor, e.g. microsoft, cisco, fortinet

name: exploited_vulnerabilities
title: Recently exploited CVEs
